title: TwinLab-Bench: Evaluating AI Scientists in Agentic Twins of Real Labs
abstract: arXiv:2611.26248v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI agents are increasingly expected to act as AI scientists, which requires three increasingly open abilities: carrying out a given computational workflow correctly, choosing the next measurements from a given design space, and designing their own experiments. Existing benchmarks mainly evaluate the first two abilities, in a terminal or in a closed loop that selects from predefined candidates. Evaluating the third ability requires reliably executing an experiment that an agent designs, with readings grounded in a real laboratory. We introduce TwinLab-Bench, which evaluates AI scientists on self-designed experiments in 52 tasks from laboratories in the physical sciences, the life sciences, and engineering. The benchmark supports more than 100 experimental action types, and the agent's report is scored by comparison with a hidden answer taken from real laboratory records. translated_title: TwinLab-Bench：在真实实验室的智能体孪生环境中评估AI科学家
translated_abstract: AI智能体日益被期望扮演AI科学家的角色，这需要三种开放性递增的能力：正确执行给定的计算工作流程、从给定的设计空间中选择下一个测量方案，以及自主设计实验。现有基准主要评估前两种能力，即通过终端或从预定义候选中进行选择的闭环方式来评估。而评估第三种能力需要可靠地执行智能体自主设计的实验，并使实验读数建立在真实实验室的基础之上。我们提出了TwinLab-Bench，该基准通过来自物理科学、生命科学和工程实验室的52个任务，评估AI科学家在自主设计实验方面的能力。该基准支持超过100种实验操作类型，智能体的报告通过与取自真实实验室记录的隐藏答案进行对比来评分。每个任务都有其专属的TwinLab智能体，该智能体充当实验环境……
tldr: 该论文提出TwinLab-Bench基准，利用来自真实物理科学、生命科学和工程实验室的52个任务，首次系统评估AI科学家自主设计实验的能力，其结果通过与真实实验室隐藏记录对比来评分。
en_tdlr: TwinLab-Bench is a benchmark of 52 tasks drawn from real physical science, life science, and engineering laboratories that, for the first time, evaluates AI scientists' ability to design their own experiments, scoring agent reports against hidden answers from real laboratory records.
